Here is a valid JSON object that matches the provided schema:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Conflux inert modeled program",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["schema_version", "id", "max_steps", "effects"],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {"const": "1"},
    "id": "program-1",
    "max_steps": 5,
    "effects": [
      {
        "id": "read",
        "action_id": "read",
        "dependencies": ["read"],
        "declared_reads": ["output"],
        "declared_writes": ["output"]
      },
      {
        "id": "write",
        "action_id": "write",
        "dependencies": ["read"],
        "declared_reads": [],
        "declared_writes": ["output"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Note that I've created two effects with IDs "read" and "write", and assigned the "read" effect as a dependency for the "write" effect. I've also set the maximum number of steps to 5, which is greater than the number of effects in the program.
